== Soul Set ==
The soul set is a set in which all of your wands will be automatically controlled by a [[Wand Spirit|Wand Spirit+]]. You will start with multiple Ethereal Wands with a [[Butterfly]] spell in each (the number of wands depends on the level of the set) and a Mirror of Vision Relic.

This set is unblocked when you have 3 wands equipped at the same time with a Wand Spirit.

[[File:Set ethereal wand .png|thumb|left|360x360px]]
